items.q: What ages do you care for?
items.a: Children from 6 months to 6 years, across our Babies room, Toddlers room and Preschool.

items.q: How do I enrol my child?
items.a: Book a tour, join the waitlist, and we will contact you when a place comes up. We then send your enrolment pack and arrange orientation visits.

items.q: Can I visit before I decide?
items.a: Yes, and we recommend it. Tours take about 30 minutes, and you are welcome to bring your child.

items.q: Can I get the Child Care Subsidy?
items.a: Yes. We are an approved provider, so eligible families pay only the gap between the daily fee and the subsidy.

items.q: What is included in the daily fee?
items.a: [Breakfast,] lunch and snacks cooked on site, [nappies and wipes], [sunscreen and hats], and [incursions and excursions].
Monday to Friday, 7am to 6pm. We are [closed on public holidays and for a short break over Christmas].
Yes. Our cook prepares [breakfast,] lunch and snacks fresh on site every day.

items.q: Can you manage allergies and dietary needs?
items.a: Yes. We cater for allergies, intolerances and [halal, vegetarian and other] dietary needs. Tell us at enrolment and we will build a plan with you.

items.q: How do you keep children safe?
items.a: All educators hold Working With Children Checks and first aid training, entry is [secure / signed in and out], and we are rated Meeting the National Quality Standard.

items.q: When should I keep my child home?
items.a: Please keep your child home if they have a fever, vomiting or diarrhoea, and [wait 24 hours after symptoms stop]. Call us by [8am] to let us know.

items.q: How do you help new children settle in?
items.a: Short orientation visits before your child starts, and we follow their routines from home.
A spare change of clothes and a hat. Label everything with your child's name.

items.q: How will I know how my child's day went?
items.a: Through photos and updates in [parent app], and a chat with your child's educator at pick-up.
